Built-in Functions

The Python interpreter has a number of functions and types built into it that are always available.

sorted(iterable, /, *, key=None, reverse=False)

Return a new sorted list from the items in iterable. Has two optional arguments which must be specified as keyword arguments.

sum(iterable, /, start=0)

Sums start and the items of an iterable from left to right and returns the total. The iterable's items are normally numbers.
